lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Do you have any shoes like these?
lines.zh: 像这样的鞋子你们有吗？

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: What size?

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Size five.

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: What colour?

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Black.

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: We don't have any.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: But my sister bought this pair last month.
lines.zh: 但是，我姐姐上个月买到了这样的一双。

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: Did she buy them here?

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: No, she bought them in the U.S.

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: We had some shoes like those a month ago,
lines.zh: 一个月前我们有这样的鞋，

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: but we don't have any now.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: Can you get a pair for me, please?

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: I'm afraid that I can't.

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: They were in fashion last year and the year before last.
lines.zh: 这鞋在去年和前年时兴，

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: But they're not in fashion this year.

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: These shoes are in fashion now.
lines.zh: 现在流行的是这种鞋子。

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.en: They look very uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 这种鞋子看上去很不舒适。

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: They are very uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.en: But women always wear uncomfortable shoes!
lines.zh: 可是女人们总是穿不舒适的鞋子！
